critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /units/{id}/reminder/email uses ObjectId(unit_id) without try/except — an invalid unit_id string will raise bson InvalidId → 500 instead of a clean 400/404. Consider wrapping and returning HTTPException(404). (Minor; observed test_reminder_email_bad_unit_404 returned 428 because gmail check runs after find_one succeeded via arbitrary 24-hex.)
